_source: Coastline: OpenMapTiles water layer via OpenFreeMap (public/basemap/water-fallback.json, ODbL). Isobaths: NOAA ETOPO 2022 15-arc-second, smoothed (public/basemap/isobaths.geojson). Web Mercator, projected for the catalog by make-fixtures.mjs. Not for navigation.

grid.sensor: Sentinel-3 OLCI 300 m latest clear view (each pixel has its own date)
